description: This file contains unit tests for the BeanFactory class in SuiteCRM, focusing on creating, retrieving, and managing beans and their metadata within the framework.

classes.name: BeanFactoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing BeanFactory functionalities such as bean creation, retrieval, metadata, and file management within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: testNewBean
methods.description: Tests creation of new beans for a module, verifying correct class instantiation before and after extension.

methods.name: testGetBean
methods.description: Tests retrieval of beans for a module, ensuring correct class instances before and after module extension.

methods.name: testGetBeanMeta
methods.description: Validates retrieval of bean metadata, comparing core and extended configurations.

methods.name: testGetBeanClass
methods.description: Checks the bean class name fetched for core and extended module configurations.

methods.name: testGetBeanName
methods.description: Ensures the bean name corresponds to the core class and differs after extension, also tests retrieval of custom bean name.

methods.name: subTestGetCustomBeanName
methods.description: Helper method to verify custom bean name retrieval and clean-up.

methods.name: testGetObjectName
methods.description: Verifies object names for core and extended modules, ensuring the correctness of standard and custom object names.

methods.name: subTestGetCustomObjectName
methods.description: Helper method to verify custom object name retrieval and clean-up.

methods.name: testGetBeanFile
methods.description: Checks the class file paths for core and extended beans, ensuring proper configuration.

methods.name: subTestGetCustomBeanFile
methods.description: Helper method to verify custom bean file retrieval and clean-up.

methods.name: testLoadBeanFile
methods.description: Tests the loading of bean class files, verifying that classes are loaded correctly after core and extension configuration.
